display_title: The Only Way to Achieve World Peace
description:
On the war-shadowed continent of Melas, Pope Heziana seeks a way to bring peace. A prophecy from the Creator God warns that the continent will soon be engulfed in war—and reveals a shocking solution to prevent it. Tasked with an outrageous divine mission in the name of peace, Heziana must prepare for peace talks with six handsome representatives from different nations. Can she fulfill her overwhelming holy duty and truly secure peace for the world?
